mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.team_id, t.team_name, b.writer_id, u.user_name as writer_name, b.title, b.created_at FROM BOARD b JOIN USERS u ON b.writer_id = u.user_id JOIN TEAM t ON b.team_id = t.team_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.board_id DESC

SELECT b.board_id, b.team_id, t.team_name, b.writer_id, u.user_name AS writer_name, b.title, b.created_at FROM BOARD b JOIN USERS u ON b.writer_id = u.user_id JOIN TEAM t ON b.team_id = t.team_id WHERE b.team_id = #{teamId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.board_id DESC
SELECT team_id, team_name FROM TEAM WHERE team_id != 7 ORDER BY team_id ASC
